posts.headline: Week 10 Preview: Drunk Indians vs Fullybaked Steals the Show
posts.body: Twelve matchups, one rivalry that matters most, and a Saturday morning guide to what you need to watch. Schefter picks winners and calls out the bubble.
content: Boom! Week 10 is here in the AFL, and I'm told the playoff picture is about to get very messy.
Get your phones ready, check the live scoreboard all afternoon, and set push notifications so you don't miss a single swing.

story: FEATURED GAME: Drunk Indians (6-5) vs Fullybaked (6-5). League sources tell me this is the rivalry of the week, and the stakes are massive.
Drunk Indians have won the last two meetings, and they carry a 60% shot at the playoffs right now. A win pushes that to about 73%.
Fullybaked own the all-time series 21-16, and they're on a three-game win streak. A loss drops their chances to roughly 20%.

The NFL game that matters here is PIT at CIN, 44.4 projected points from these two teams' starters. Aaron Rodgers (23.9) and Ja'Marr Chase (20.5) are the Drunk Indians engine, and that Chase matchup is the one to watch.
Josh Allen (30.3) is the single biggest projection in this entire game, and Fullybaked are riding him hard.
Money is nice, but championships are better. My pick: Drunk Indians, because Rodgers and Chase are too much to ignore. Check the rivalry pages for the full history.
No Soup For You (6-5) vs Badd Boys (3-8). No Soup For You are at 39% playoff odds, and a win pushes them to 49%.
Travis Kelce (14.5) and Rashee Rice (15.5) are the weapons. My pick: No Soup For You.
Swiftie 4 Life (7-4) vs Jewpacabra (5-6). Swiftie 4 Life are at 88% playoff odds, but Jewpacabra have won the last three meetings.
Joe Burrow (30.1) anchors Swiftie 4 Life. My pick: Swiftie 4 Life, though Jewpacabra are dangerous.
Da Dangsters (4-7) vs Suh girls, one cup (8-3). Suh girls have won three straight meetings, and they are in the thick of the race.
Tyler Shough (25.9) gives Da Dangsters a real shot, but Trey McBride (23.4) is the Suh girls difference-maker. My pick: Suh girls, one cup.
Chatmaster (4-7) vs A Bruin Pegs Me (5-6). A Bruin Pegs Me are at 27% playoff odds and a win pushes that to 35%.
Caleb Williams (25.6) is the difference-maker. My pick: A Bruin Pegs Me.
Get off my Ditka (6-5) vs Smokane FC (8-3). Smokane FC have won all three meetings, and Joe Burrow (30.1) is a monster.
Smokane FC are already at 98% playoff odds. My pick: Smokane FC, and Get off my Ditka need help.
The Boondock Saints (5-6) vs Muck Juggling Micks (4-7). The Boondock Saints have won the last three meetings and are outplaying their scores by 1.6 wins.
Ja'Marr Chase (20.5) is the Micks' weapon. My pick: The Boondock Saints.
Avenging Amish (5-6) vs Vitside Mafia (3-8). Vitside Mafia have underperformed their scores by 3.2 wins, which is a red flag.
Jared Goff (27.5) carries Avenging Amish. My pick: Avenging Amish, and Vitside Mafia need a wake-up call.
Midwestside Connection (5-6) vs Computer Jocks (4-7). Computer Jocks lead the series 17-7, but Midwestside are riding a five-game losing streak.
Brock Bowers (22.9) is the key for Computer Jocks. My pick: Computer Jocks.
Titsburgh Feelers (4-7) vs Balls Deep (10-1). Balls Deep are on a seven-game win streak and sit at 100% playoff odds.
Dak Prescott (27.4) leads the charge. My pick: Balls Deep.
Team Minty Fresh (3-8) vs Dicks out for Harambe (8-3). Dicks out for Harambe are at 98% playoff odds and look locked in.
Dak Prescott (27.4) and Bo Nix (27.1) power that roster. My pick: Dicks out for Harambe, easily.
The Mariachi Ninjas (10-1) vs The Show (3-8). The Mariachi Ninjas have won six straight meetings.
Jonathan Taylor (20.1) is the engine. My pick: The Mariachi Ninjas, and The Show need a miracle.

closing: Broadcast guide: watch CIN and PIT, where Ja'Marr Chase and Aaron Rodgers decide the featured game.
Also keep an eye on BUF, where Josh Allen headlines Fullybaked and Titsburgh Feelers. Check the Sunday Ticket board and your lineup before kickoff.
